entries.title: Delete the Gmail and Calendar content your crew read
entries.body: What your first mate and crew read from Gmail and Calendar now stays in their saved conversations for 30 days, then a short note takes its place. To delete it sooner, use Delete Gmail and Calendar content in Settings → General: it replaces everything read so far and keeps your tasks and their conversations. What they wrote themselves, in cards, notes and files, stays until you delete the task.

picture.alt: Settings → General with a new row, Delete Gmail and Calendar content, under Purge task data: it replaces what the crew read with a note and says it also goes on its own 30 days after it was read.
